title: Sherpa voice ASR screen UI validation (parametrized)
description: Drives the actual /features/asr screen end-to-end (model picker -> init -> audio picker -> recognize -> read transcript). Params: modelId (registry key) and audioId (test_wavs/<audioId>.wav). Uses a full-tree fiber walker for the model/audio pickers because they are horizontal virtualized FlatLists and the target item may be off-screen.

select-model.expression: (function(){var A=globalThis.__AGENTIC__;var TARGET='model-option-{{modelId}}';function findFiber(){var found=null;function walk(fiber){if(!fiber||found)return;var p=fiber.memoizedProps;if(p&&p.testID===TARGET){found=fiber;return;}if(fiber.child)walk(fiber.child);if(fiber.sibling)walk(fiber.sibling);}var anchor=A.findFiberByTestId('btn-init-asr')||A.findFiberByTestId('btn-recognize')||A.findFiberByTestId('btn-release-asr');if(!anchor)return null;var root=anchor;while(root.return)root=root.return;walk(root);return found;}return new Promise(function(resolve){var attempts=0;function tick(){var f=findFiber();if(f){var onPress=f.memoizedProps&&f.memoizedProps.onPress;if(typeof onPress==='function'){try{onPress();resolve({status:'pressed',testId:TARGET});}catch(e){resolve({status:'error',error:String(e)});}return;}resolve({status:'no-onpress'});return;}attempts++;if(attempts>=40){resolve({status:'not-found',testId:TARGET});return;}setTimeout(tick,500);}tick();});})()

select-audio.expression: (function(){var A=globalThis.__AGENTIC__;var TARGET='audio-option-{{audioId}}';function findFiber(){var found=null;function walk(fiber){if(!fiber||found)return;var p=fiber.memoizedProps;if(p&&p.testID===TARGET){found=fiber;return;}if(fiber.child)walk(fiber.child);if(fiber.sibling)walk(fiber.sibling);}var anchor=A.findFiberByTestId('btn-release-asr');if(!anchor)return null;var root=anchor;while(root.return)root=root.return;walk(root);return found;}return new Promise(function(resolve){var attempts=0;function tick(){var f=findFiber();if(f){var onPress=f.memoizedProps&&f.memoizedProps.onPress;if(typeof onPress==='function'){try{onPress();resolve({status:'pressed',testId:TARGET});}catch(e){resolve({status:'error',error:String(e)});}return;}resolve({status:'no-onpress'});return;}attempts++;if(attempts>=40){resolve({status:'not-found',testId:TARGET});return;}setTimeout(tick,500);}tick();});})()

wait-result.expression: (function(){var A=globalThis.__AGENTIC__;function readResult(){var fiber=A.findFiberByTestId('text-recognition-result');if(!fiber)return null;var c=fiber.memoizedProps&&fiber.memoizedProps.children;if(typeof c==='string')return c;if(Array.isArray(c))return c.filter(function(x){return typeof x==='string';}).join('');return null;}return new Promise(function(resolve){var i=0;function tick(){var t=readResult();if(t!==null&&t!==''&&t!=='(no speech detected)'){resolve({status:'success',transcript:t});return;}if(t==='(no speech detected)'){resolve({status:'no-speech-detected',transcript:t});return;}i++;if(i>=240){resolve({status:'timeout'});return;}setTimeout(tick,500);}tick();});})()
